dataset_metadata.name: SentinelForge command semantics challenge
dataset_metadata.provenance: Separately authored synthetic scenarios, never captured operational telemetry
dataset_metadata.labeling_criteria: Assigned action intent is explicit in reason; expected_rule_ids describe prespecified semantic contracts and need not agree with intent. Labels never enter telemetry.
dataset_metadata.independence: All partitions authored and frozen before v3 detector evaluation. Shared rule domains, constructor code and engineer authorship create correlation; this is not blinded, independent operational validation.

unit: Scenario; any emitted alert predicts suspicious. No label or scenario metadata is sent to detection.

provenance.clock_policy: One explicitly recorded UTC time for every scenario; never selected from a label

metadata.freeze_policy: All partitions frozen together before any v3 outcome. No overwrite option; corrections require a new version and preserved original artifacts.
metadata.scope: Five selected command/context rule domains; no claim about complete rule coverage or field efficacy
metadata.access_order: Freeze all; development for tuning; validation for selection; freeze candidate; holdout once for report. Any reuse is development evidence thereafter.

latency_ms.definition: HTTP TestClient ingestion to committed response, alerting scenarios only; excludes operator context provisioning, network transit and observation delay

limitations: Synthetic experiments, not deployment efficacy or representative prevalence

Any rejected/failed scenario invalidates headline metrics; no implicit benign prediction
No population FPR below 5% is established by these point estimates
